title: Nodia Item Utilities
description:
A spigot plugin that allows the creation of Custom Items and Blocks with config files for each Item/Block

CustomModelData is supported!
body:
NIU is a spigot plugin for adding custom blocks and items using config files for each custom item/block.

There is 2 file templates that are in the plugin's data folder to learn how it works.

commands:
- /nb give [ID]: gives the custom item/block from the id you assigned in its config.
- /nreload: reloads current configs and adds new ones.

All current config options (Contact me on discord if you have suggestions: kane44hd):
